_doc.purpose: Master terminology dictionary. Single source of truth for canonical labels used across Projects, Financials, CRM, HR, Timesheet, Forecast and Permissions.
_doc.rule: Modules MUST reference these keys via t('glossary:<group>.<term>') instead of redeclaring the same concept locally.
_doc.ptCanonical: When the EN UI renders a term that has a Portuguese legal/payroll canonical form, render it as 'EN label (PT canonical)' on first occurrence using <Term k='...' /> — see ptCanonical field per term.
_doc.entityRule: Use entity.* for the master entity label (the record itself). For relationship/role wording (e.g. 'Client approval', 'belongs to client'), use the contextual key (e.g. relation.client). Never substitute 'Client' for 'Company' as the master entity.

entity._doc: Master entity nouns — the record types themselves. Reuse these wherever a UI labels a record (table headers, form labels, picker placeholders, breadcrumbs).

relation._doc: Relationship/role wording — never replaces entity.*. Use only when the sentence describes a role (e.g. 'Client approval', 'Project lead').

ptCanonical._doc: Canonical Portuguese legal/payroll terms. EN UI renders 'EN label (PT canonical)' on first occurrence via <Term> component. Never translate these away — they are legal terms.

_ambiguous._doc: Terms flagged for product clarification — currently used inconsistently. Do NOT use these as canonical until resolved.
_ambiguous.value: Used as proposal value, generic numeric value, or budget. Standardize per context.
_ambiguous.usage: Sometimes 'utilization', sometimes 'capacity used'. Distinguish ratio vs absolute hours.
_ambiguous.rate: Always disambiguate as 'Cost Rate' or 'Sale Rate'.
_ambiguous.fee: PT-only legal/business term retained even in EN UI per Portuguese practice.
